title: PHASE 4.1.1 — RECONCILED RHSI & PFG ADVISORY SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
weight_provenance_explanation: Balanced linear proxy-skill weights across active heuristic response equations (Albakor Component 1 zeroed because circular proxy AUC = 0.507 <= 0.51). Labeled PROVISIONAL_ANALYST_SELECTED_WEIGHTS because underlying AUCs are evaluated against deterministic environmental proxy points rather than independent empirical field catch coordinates.

diagnostic_explanations.madidihang_389_cell_invariance_at_tau_06: Within <=60 NM (804 cells), Component 2 (hsi_rf) is a discrete 4-rule step function (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). Cells passing 3 of 4 rules (hsi_rf >= 0.75, n = 389 cells) achieve visualization_score >= 0.708 under canonical weights, whereas cells passing <=2 rules (hsi_rf <= 0.50) have visualization_score <= 0.548. Because no cell has visualization_score in the interval (0.548, 0.708), thresholding at tau = 0.65 falls inside this 0.160-wide discrete step gap and selects the exact same 389 cells across all weight schemes. At tau = 0.75 (or when thresholding weighted_mean_rhsi >= 0.65), cell counts vary across weight schemes (from 194 to 389 cells at tau=0.75, and 585 to 601 cells for weighted_mean_rhsi >= 0.65).
diagnostic_explanations.albakor_zero_penalized_advisory_vs_230_p: In functional_zones_albakor.geojson, PFG screening zones are defined by weighted_mean_rhsi >= 0.50 within <=60 NM, which yields 230 qualifying cells (6,887.01 km2) under canonical weights (and 277 cells AOI-wide). However, because Component 3 (hsi_glm, calibrated for cooler subtropical waters) outputs 0.004-0.012 at 24.8-26.2 C while Component 2 (hsi_rf) outputs 1.00 in deep slope waters, inter-component disagreement sigma_w is ~0.495. Consequently, penalized raw_advisory_score = weighted_mean_rhsi - 0.5 * sigma_w peaks at 0.276 (< 0.50), yielding 0 cells if tau = 0.50 is applied to the penalized score. Both metrics (pfg_zone_cells_by_weighted_mean_rhsi and penalized_advisory_cells_by_vis_score) are now explicitly tabulated.
